title: Festive Veggie Sausages
subtitle: and Sweet Potato Smash with Cranberry Relish
description: This festive season, sit down to vegetarian kale and cashew sausages slathered with a delicious sweet onion and cranberry relish and paired with broccolini and thyme-laced sweet potato. It's Christmas flavours for young and old.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Cut the sweet potato into 2-3 cm chunks. Cut the broccolini in half lengthwise. Slice the onion. Pick half the thyme leaves, discarding the stems.

Roast sweet potato: Put the sweet potato on the lined tray and toss with the thyme leaves and 2 tsp olive oil. Season with salt and pepper, then spread in a single layer. Roast for 23-25 mins until starting to brown. Add the broccolini to the tray and roast for a further 6-8 mins until the broccolini is charred and the sweet potato is tender and golden.

Make relish: Meanwhile, heat 10g butter in a small frypan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until tender. Add the cranberries, 2 tbs balsamic vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and 60ml (¼ cup) water and cook for 5-7 mins until thickened and sticky.
Cook sausages: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the sausages, turning, for 4-5 mins until golden and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Put the roasted sweet potato in a bowl and roughly smash with a potato masher. Divide the smash, sausages and broccolini among plates, spoon over the cranberry relish and enjoy.
Did you know?: Our sausages are a great plant-based sausage substitute. Made with kale, brown rice and cashews, the sausages are gluten free and contain no artificial flavourings or additives.
